name: dev-tracker
description: A personal tracker for learning, solved problems and job applications. The site itself has no runtime dependencies; jsdom is only used to test it.

scripts.test: npm run test:store && npm run test:extension && npm run test:browser
scripts.test:browser: node tests/browser/app.test.mjs && node tests/browser/boot.test.mjs && node tests/browser/styles.test.mjs
